axes.concept: A measured assembly stage derived from tables, Tiffany chairs, round panels, balloon rigs and physical set building.
axes.layout: Three unequal tracks: a 112px tool spine, a flexible axonometric scene and a 350px ruled inspector; mobile stacks navigation, stage and inspector.
axes.navigation: Six explicit vertical tool stations with icon and text, an offset bracket for the active station, and named header triggers for shopping Dialog and export Popover; no bottom dock or gesture requirement.
axes.typography: Shared system sans with 24px project title and 26px inspector heading; monospaced 24px dimension fields, 32px placed-chair total and 14px scene measurements.
axes.density: Open scene against a compact working folio; 24px structural gaps, 26px panel padding, 44px controls and a two-column shelf of illustrated objects.
axes.components: Real shadcn/Base UI Button, Input, Textarea and Skeleton; Animate UI Dialog and Popover; custom measured SVG stage, tool spine, ruled list and object silhouettes.
axes.colour: Existing Pictures Taller neutral surfaces and lavender accent mapped to shadcn roles; light #6d3fe0/white and dark #b9a4ff/#120b24 actions, high-contrast input edges. Material colours belong to scene data.
axes.motion: Elastic spatial settling: table drops onto the floor, Backing lifts into position after a short stagger, inspector aligns against its registration corner; dashed rulers resolve and object thumbnails lift/tilt on hover. Profile-aware springs, immediate reduced-motion and still-mode parity.
